name: l_bracket_rib
description: Aluminium L-bracket with triangular reinforcement rib — dimensional + feature gates plus a standalone FEM check.

stages.prompt:
Aluminium L-bracket (6061) with a triangular reinforcement rib, parametric.

Frame: X=length, Y=width, Z=height; base plate rests on the XY plane, centred at origin; mm units.
- Base flange: 80 (X) x 60 (Y) x 6 (Z) plate.
- Upright flange: 80 (X) x 60 (Y) x 6 thick plate standing at the -X edge, rising to 66 mm total height above the table.
- Four M8 clearance holes dia 8.5 mm: two through the base flange along Z at (x=+25, y=+20) and (x=+25, y=-20); two through the upright flange along X at (y=+20, z=+36) and (y=-20, z=+36).
- Triangular reinforcement rib: 4 mm thick, centred in Y, in the inside corner between base top face and upright inner face; legs ~40 mm long.
- Fillets: 2 mm at outer edges, 3 mm in the inner L corner and at the rib junctions.
Part must be symmetric in Y and dimensionally exact; expose the key dimensions as parameters.
